caption: The drawing depicts a single vessel, likely a pot or jar, placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The vessel has a rounded, bulbous lower half and a straighter, slightly flared upper half with an uneven, wavy rim at the top. The color palette used on the vessel consists primarily of brown and reddish-brown tones, interspersed with subtle hints of green, blue, and purple, creating a slightly mottled appearance. There are also lighter and darker areas on the surface, suggesting reflections and the interplay of light and shadow on its rounded form. No other objects or decorative elements are present in the composition, and the background remains blank and unadorned.
title: Terra Cotta Flower Jar
